walkthroughs.body_html:
Find the domain of f(x) = √(x-3).

Need x - 3 ≥ 0, so domain is x ≥ 3, i.e. [3, ∞).

Find the inverse of f(x) = 3x - 5.

Let y = 3x - 5, swap: x = 3y - 5, solve y = (x+5)/3. So f^(-1)(x) = (x+5)/3.
